newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil holds steady on tighter supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil holds steady on tighter supply.

text.p: European spot gas oil prices held a steady line over the day with tighter supply countering late small losses on benchmark gas oil futures, traders said.

They said persistent dollar strength over the mark, though slightly weaker on Monday, was keeping demand from the key inland market thin while steady futures and a small contango of $1 per tonne to August kept most buyers scarce.

"Gas oil (IPE futures) looks as if there's still room to come lower so many end-users are holding back for a drop below $160. But tighter ARA supplies could support prices and pull buyers back in soon," one barge broker said.
Prompt delivery diesel cargoes were valued around July IPE +$4 with second half cargoes valued at August IPE +$3.75 cif Le Havre following trade at the level on Friday.
0.2 sulphur cargoes were pegged steady around July IPE +$2 with the tightening Rotterdam supply supportive.
Prompt lifting barges traded between July IPE +50 cents/+$1 a tonne with second half July lifting valued flat around 75 cents over the July screen.
